ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: The weekly (investor-cycle) momentum just crossed UP while price holds its 10-day average — the start of a new multi-month up-leg. A daily-overbought print here is the launch thrust, not a top, so this is a HOLD / ride, not a take-profit. The daily can still dip to its 10-day average (normal) — but the bigger investor cycle is early, with room left. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Hold / ride the fresh weekly up-leg; add on pullbacks toward the 10-day average rather than chasing the thrust. First warning would be the weekly momentum rolling back over.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 21 · daily cycle day 12).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): uptrend. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
ladder.synthesis_line: Daily is hot (RSI 75, day 12/42 — a dip is normal soon), but the weekly investor cycle just turned up — so this is HOLD / ride a new up-leg, not take-profits.
ladder.synthesis_line_zh: 日线偏热（RSI 75，周期第 12 天——短期回调属正常），但周线投资者周期刚刚向上转向——因此应持有 / 顺势新上行段，而非止盈。
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.
entry.text_zh: 趋势完好——持有；可在回调至 10 日均线附近时加仓。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 12 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 12 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 21 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: late — the bigger cycle is getting old
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 21 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 晚期——更大的周期已趋于老化
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 周线（投资者周期）动量刚刚向上交叉，且价格守住 10 日均线——这是新的多月上行段的起点。此处日线超买只是启动推力、并非见顶，因此应持有 / 顺势，而非止盈。日线仍可能回踩 10 日均线（属正常）——但更大的投资者周期尚处早期，仍有空间。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 持有 / 顺应新的周线上行段；在回踩 10 日均线时加仓，而非追高推力。首个预警将是周线动量重新掉头向下。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量刚刚向上交叉；3 日线向上交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 21 周 · 日线周期第 12 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-26), switching from BOTTOMING. Signal strength: moderate (score +45/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-26），自筑底中切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 +45/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入形态（+25）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

caveats: Risk cone (drawdown/vol) is the validated read; DIRECTION is display-only (measured coin-flip).
Cone widens with horizon; downside tail is the forecastable left side.
Long per-name cone is thin/under-powered — defer to the sector cone.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (40) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（40）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up
reasons.zh: 在上沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘突破即向上释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +11.4 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +11.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
